_comment: Editorial judgments the source text cannot express. Hand-maintained.
requiredCount: how many DISTINCT answers the user must supply. Not derivable
from the prompt wording -- Q16 says 'three branches' and Q19 says 'two parts',
but each has a single compound answer bullet listing them, so both are 1.
Only these seven questions ask for more than one bullet from a list.
dynamic: questions whose answer changes with elections or appointments, or
depends on where the user lives. Their answers are resolved at runtime from
the officials dataset, so the bank ships them with an empty answers array.
